description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Sri Lanka Accounting Standard SLFRS 16 Leases be effective for financial statements covering period commencing on or after 01.01.2019
reasoning: This gazette content involves the adoption of a new accounting standard (SLFRS 16 Leases) by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka under the authority of the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for financial reporting, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
